customManagers.description: Rust toolchain pin. Renovate has no built-in manager for rust-toolchain.toml, and rust-lang/rust carries pre-1.0 tags that sort ahead of the versions wanted, so its GitHub releases are the datasource.

packageRules.description: Scala Steward owns Scala dependencies. Renovate's sbt manager reads the same build definitions and would raise a competing pull request for every one of them.
